text:
alex: Quick check — we need to lock a 30m engineering sync next week to walk the RFC review, final canary plan, smoke test owners, and rollback criteria before the release. Two proposed slots: Tue 10:00-10:30 PT (Tue 17:00 UTC) or Wed 08:00-08:30 PT (Wed 15:00 UTC). Please reply with the slot you can do or suggest an alternative. Agenda draft below — add items or note owners.

alex: Agenda:
```
- RFC: feature/async-batching (10m) — @maya
- Canary plan & capacity targets (8m) — @sam
- Smoke owners & quick test checklist (6m) — @linh
- Rollback conditions & playbook (6m) — eng-sre
``` 

maya: Tue 10 works for me, can handle the RFC.

sam: Wed 08 is better for me, but I can join Tue if needed. I'll prep the canary numbers.

linh: I have a conflict on Tue morning, Wed 08 works. I updated the smoke checklist doc: https://redwood.docs/smoke-checklist (see "quick checks" section)

alex: If we split, can we do Tue for RFC + rollback, Wed for canary deep-dive? Prefer single meeting though. Also need a canary owner and a rollback owner — volunteers?

sam: I can be canary owner. Will set perf targets and add to the agenda.

maya: I can be rollback owner for the RFC-related changes.

release-bot: Calendar poll created: https://calendar.poll/abc123 — add your vote. Event will reserve 30m on the primary chosen slot.

alex: Perfect. @everyone — if you have blockers before the sync, drop them here. Specifically: outstanding PRs, infra migrations, or monitoring gaps.

maya: PR #457 is still pending final review (waiting on perf test results). ETA EOD Monday.

linh: Infra migration to new KV cache landed in staging but needs smoke verification — I'll do that tonight.

sam: No blockers from my side; I'll post the canary metric baseline by Monday morning.

alex: Great—I'll lock the poll by 11am PT tomorrow and send the calendar invite with the final agenda and links. Thanks :thumbsup:
